title: OntoTKGE: Ontology-Enhanced Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation
abstract: arXiv:2604.05468v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Temporal knowledge graph (TKG) extrapolation is an important task that aims to predict future facts through historical interaction information within KG snapshots. A key challenge for most existing TKG extrapolation models is handling entities with sparse historical interaction. The ontological knowledge is beneficial for alleviating this sparsity issue by enabling these entities to inherit behavioral patterns from other entities with the same concept, which is ignored by previous studies. In this paper, we propose a novel encoder-decoder framework OntoTKGE that leverages the ontological knowledge from the ontology-view KG (i.e., a KG modeling hierarchical relations among abstract concepts as well as the connections between concepts and entities) to guide the TKG extrapolation model's learning process through the effective integration of the ontological and temporal knowledge, thereby enhancing entity embeddings. translated_title: OntoTKGE：本体增强的时序知识图谱外推
translated_abstract: 时序知识图谱（TKG）外推是一项重要任务，旨在通过知识图谱快照中的历史交互信息来预测未来事实。现有大多数时序知识图谱外推模型面临的一个关键挑战是处理历史交互稀疏的实体。本体知识有助于缓解这种稀疏性问题，因为它使这些实体能够从具有相同概念的其他实体继承行为模式，而这一点在以往的研究中被忽视了。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的编码器-解码器框架OntoTKGE，该框架利用本体视图知识图谱（即对抽象概念之间的层级关系以及概念与实体之间的连接进行建模的知识图谱）中的本体知识，通过有效整合本体知识与时序知识来指导时序知识图谱外推模型的学习过程，从而增强实体嵌入。OntoTKGE具有灵活性。
tldr: 提出OntoTKGE框架，利用本体视图知识图谱中的本体知识，使历史交互稀疏的实体能够从相同概念的其他实体继承行为模式，通过融合本体知识与时序知识增强实体嵌入，从而提升时序知识图谱外推的性能。
en_tdlr: OntoTKGE is a novel encoder-decoder framework that leverages ontological knowledge from ontology-view KGs, enabling entities with sparse historical interactions to inherit behavioral patterns from conceptually related entities, thereby enhancing TKG extrapolation through the effective integration of ontological and temporal knowledge.
